verdict.rationale: mParticle documents a Data Subject Request API (v3, opendsr.mparticle.com) for GDPR/CCPA requests. Its Data Privacy Controls cover suppression: CCPA data-sale opt-out can drive a forwarding rule that blocks data from going to destinations. However, nothing in the pack shows deletion or erasure requests being forwarded to connected destinations. Missing for 10: documented deletion/erasure processing workflow, propagation of deletion requests to downstream destinations, request status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can process user deletion and suppression requests (GDPR/CCPA) and have them forwarded to connected destinations
